title: 811. Largest Sum of Averages

examples.explanation: Split as [9],[1,2,3],[9] with averages 9, 2 and 9 summing to 20.
An optimal cut places larger values in their own groups to lift the total.
A single group averages to its only element.

hints: This is a portable adaptation: return the score as a finite, double-parseable decimal string.
Precompute prefix sums so the average of any interval is O(1), then DP over prefixes and group counts.
Let dp[i][g] be the best total for the first i numbers in g groups; extend it by trying every start of the last group.
